title: 9-day upper circuit: Multibagger small-cap stock surges 55% in September despite weak market
text: 9-day upper circuit: Multibagger small-cap stock surges 55% in September despite weak market. Spice Lounge Food Works defied market trends with a 55.5% return in September, locking in a 5% upper circuit for nine sessions. The surge follows the launch of its food emulsifiers and agribusiness division, aiming for ₹1,200 crore in revenue potential and expanded global partnerships.
